title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
moral: Get ready ahead of time and share together, and everyone stays warm.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.ants:line | ants:pass | ants:carry:<n> |: 개미 줄·지나가기·나르기(곡식→창고)·잎 우산·옷 입기(wear)·창고로 들어가기·대장 개미·집주인 개미·아기 개미
acts.cut:<sneeze|shiver|door>: 만화 컷 — 컷 속 외침(VOICE_LINES cut_*)을 그대로 재사용

lines.text: 여름이에요. 개미들이 줄지어 먹이를 날라요.
lines.en: It's summer. The ants march in a line, carrying food.
segs: It's summer. The ants march in a line, carrying food.

lines.text: 영차영차! 개미들은 땀을 뻘뻘 흘리며 곡식을 날랐어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The ants carried grain, dripping with sweat.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The ants carried grain, dripping with sweat.

lines.text: 그 옆에서 베짱이는 풀잎 그늘에 벌렁 누워 있었지요.
lines.en: Right next to them, the grasshopper lay flopped in the shade of a leaf.
segs: Right next to them, the grasshopper lay flopped in the shade of a leaf.

lines.text: "여름은 신나! 띠리링~" 베짱이는 노래를 불러요.
lines.en: "Summer is so fun! Tra-la-la~" The grasshopper sings a song.

lines.text: 개미 눈으로 보면 풀잎이 나무처럼 커다래요!
lines.en: Through an ant's eyes, blades of grass look as big as trees!
segs: Through an ant's eyes, blades of grass look as big as trees!

lines.text: 노란 곡식 알갱이도 개미한테는 커다란 바위 같았지요.
lines.en: Even a yellow grain was like a big boulder to an ant.
segs: Even a yellow grain was like a big boulder to an ant.

lines.text: 개미들은 하나씩 번쩍 들어 창고로 뚜벅뚜벅 날랐어요.
lines.en: One by one, the ants lifted them up and marched, stomp, stomp, to the storeroom.
segs: One by one, the ants lifted them up and marched, stomp, stomp, to the storeroom.

lines.text: 창고 칸이 가득 찼어요! 하나부터 열까지, 열 칸!
lines.en: The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!
segs: The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!

lines.text: "같이 놀자~ 띠리링!" 베짱이가 노래해요.
lines.en: "Let's play together~ Tra-la-la!" the grasshopper sings.

lines.text: 꽃들이 살랑살랑, 나비가 팔랑팔랑 춤을 췄어요.
lines.en: The flowers swayed, sway, sway, and the butterflies fluttered, flit, flit, in a dance.
segs: The flowers swayed, sway, sway, and the butterflies fluttered, flit, flit, in a dance.

lines.text: 지나가던 개미들이 말했어요. "우린 겨울 준비해야 해!"
lines.en: Some ants passing by said, "We have to get ready for winter!"
segs: We have to get ready for winter!

lines.text: "겨울은 아직 멀었는걸~" 베짱이는 또 노래했어요.
lines.en: "Winter is still far away~" the grasshopper sang again.

lines.text: 개미들은 고개를 절레절레 흔들며 지나갔어요.
lines.en: The ants shook their heads, no, no, and marched on by.
segs: The ants shook their heads, no, no, and marched on by.

lines.text: 앗, 소나기가 와요! 후두둑 후두둑!
lines.en: Oh no, a rain shower! Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!
segs: Oh no, a rain shower! Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!

lines.text: 개미들은 커다란 잎을 번쩍 들어 우산처럼 펼쳤어요.
lines.en: The ants lifted a great big leaf and opened it up like an umbrella.
segs: The ants lifted a great big leaf and opened it up like an umbrella.

lines.text: 잎 우산 아래 개미들은 뽀송뽀송해요.
lines.en: Under the leaf umbrella, the ants are nice and dry.
segs: Under the leaf umbrella, the ants are nice and dry.

lines.text: 빗방울이 베짱이 머리 위로 주룩주룩 쏟아졌어요.
lines.en: Raindrops came pouring, drip, drop, splash, right on the grasshopper's head.
segs: Raindrops came pouring, drip, drop, splash, right on the grasshopper's head.

lines.text: 베짱이는 혼자 흠뻑 젖었어요. 에취! 그래도 "괜찮아~" 하고 웃었어요.
lines.en: The grasshopper got soaking wet, all alone. Achoo! But the grasshopper said, "It's okay~" and smiled.
segs: The grasshopper got soaking wet, all alone.

lines.text: 가을이 왔어요. 나뭇잎이 알록달록 휘날려요.
lines.en: Autumn has come. Colorful leaves are fluttering down.
segs: Autumn has come. Colorful leaves are fluttering down.

lines.text: 개미들은 도토리를 데굴데굴 굴려 창고로 날랐어요.
lines.en: The ants rolled acorns, roll, roll, roll, all the way to the storeroom.
segs: The ants rolled acorns, roll, roll, roll, all the way to the storeroom.

lines.text: 창고가 도토리로 더 가득해졌어요!
lines.en: The storeroom is even fuller with acorns!
segs: The storeroom is even fuller with acorns!

lines.text: 바람이 선선해요.
lines.en: The wind is cool.

lines.text: 개미들은 으슬으슬 추울까 봐 가벼운 재킷을 걸쳤어요.
lines.en: Brr, it was getting chilly, so the ants put on light jackets.
segs: Brr, it was getting chilly, so the ants put on light jackets.

lines.text: 하얀 눈이 펑펑! 겨울이 왔어요. 호호, 추워라.
lines.en: Big white snowflakes are falling! Winter is here. Brrr, so cold.
segs: Big white snowflakes are falling! Winter is here.

lines.text: 개미들은 오들오들 떨며 서로 꼭 붙었어요.
lines.en: The ants shivered, brrr, brrr, and huddled close together.
segs: The ants shivered, brrr, brrr, and huddled close together.

lines.text: 눈이 오면 머리랑 목을 따뜻하게!
lines.en: When it snows, keep your head and neck warm!
segs: When it snows, keep your head and neck warm!

lines.text: 개미들은 폭신한 목도리와 털모자를 쓰고 방긋 웃었어요.
lines.en: The ants put on fluffy scarves and fur hats and smiled big smiles.
segs: The ants put on fluffy scarves and fur hats and smiled big smiles.

lines.text: 개미들은 따뜻한 창고로 쏙 들어갔어요.
lines.en: The ants hurried into the warm storeroom.
segs: The ants hurried into the warm storeroom.

lines.text: 눈 오는 날, 베짱이가 오들오들 떨며 창고 문을 두드렸어요.
lines.en: On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.
segs: On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.

lines.text: "개미야, 먹을 것 좀 나눠 줄 수 있니?"
lines.en: "Ant, could you share some food with me?"
segs: Ant, could you share some food with me?

lines.text: 개미가 물었어요. "여름엔 뭘 했니?"
lines.en: The ant asked, "What did you do in the summer?"
segs: What did you do in the summer?

lines.text: "노래했지. 띠리링~"
lines.en: "I sang. Tra-la-la~"

lines.text: "그럼 겨울엔 춤이나 추렴!"
lines.en: "Then go dance all winter!"

lines.text: 베짱이는 고개를 푹 숙이고 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.
lines.en: The grasshopper hung its head low and sniffled, sniff, sniff.
segs: The grasshopper hung its head low and sniffled, sniff, sniff.

lines.text: 그때 아기 개미가 말했어요. "그래도 추워 보여요."
lines.en: Then the baby ant said, "But Grasshopper looks so cold."

lines.text: "우리 창고엔 먹을 게 아주 많잖아요." 개미는 잠깐 생각하다가 빙긋 웃었어요.
lines.en: "And our storeroom has lots and lots of food." The ant thought for a moment, and then smiled.
segs: And our storeroom has lots and lots of food.
The ant thought for a moment, and then smiled.

lines.text: "어서 들어와요! 같이 겨울을 나요."
lines.en: "Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together."
segs: Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together.

lines.text: "고마워요! 대신 내가 멋진 음악을 들려줄게요!"
lines.en: "Thank you! In return, I'll play you some wonderful music!"
segs: Thank you! In return, I'll play you some wonderful music!

lines.text: 창고 안이 곡식이랑 도토리로 가득해요! 여름부터 미리 모은 덕분이에요.
lines.en: The storeroom is full of grain and acorns! That's thanks to gathering ahead of time since summer.
segs: The storeroom is full of grain and acorns! That's thanks to gathering ahead of time since summer.

lines.text: 베짱이에게 목도리와 털모자도 나눠 줬어요.
lines.en: They shared a scarf and a fur hat with the grasshopper, too.
segs: They shared a scarf and a fur hat with the grasshopper, too.

lines.text: 베짱이는 따뜻한 수프를 후루룩 마시고 배를 통통 두드렸어요.
lines.en: The grasshopper slurped up warm soup and patted its full tummy, pat, pat.
segs: The grasshopper slurped up warm soup and patted its full tummy, pat, pat.

lines.text: 먹을 게 이렇게 많으니 친구들도 불러요!
lines.en: There's so much to eat, so let's invite friends!
segs: There's so much to eat, so let's invite friends!

lines.text: 무당벌레, 달팽이, 쥐며느리, 반딧불이가 줄줄이 찾아왔어요.
lines.en: A ladybug, a snail, a pill bug, and a firefly came in, one after another.
segs: A ladybug, a snail, a pill bug, and a firefly came in, one after another.

lines.text: 친구가 넷이나 왔어요! 먹을 게 많아서 모두 나눠 먹을 수 있어요.
lines.en: Four friends came! There's lots of food, so everyone can share.
segs: Four friends came! There's lots of food, so everyone can share.

lines.text: 반딧불이가 불을 밝히고, 겨울 음악회가 시작됐어요!
lines.en: The firefly lit up its light, and the winter concert began!
segs: The firefly lit up its light, and the winter concert began!

lines.text: 베짱이가 겨울 노래를 들려줘요. 가만히 들어 봐요.
lines.en: The grasshopper plays a winter song. Listen quietly.
segs: The grasshopper plays a winter song. Listen quietly.

lines.text: 띠리링~ 친구들은 어깨를 들썩들썩, 발을 콩콩 굴렀어요.
lines.en: Tra-la-la~ The friends bounced their shoulders and stomped their feet, stomp, stomp.
segs: Tra-la-la~ The friends bounced their shoulders and stomped their feet, stomp, stomp.

lines.text: 창고 밖엔 눈이 펑펑 내렸지만, 안은 포근포근했지요.
lines.en: Outside the storeroom, the snow fell thick and heavy, but inside it was warm and snug.
segs: Outside the storeroom, the snow fell thick and heavy, but inside it was warm and snug.

lines.text: 띠리링~ 짝짝짝! 겨울이 하나도 춥지 않았어요.
lines.en: Tra-la-la~ Clap, clap, clap! Winter wasn't cold at all.
segs: Tra-la-la~ Clap, clap, clap! Winter wasn't cold at all.

lines.text: 따뜻한 봄이 왔어요. 새싹이 쏙쏙!
lines.en: Warm spring has come. Little sprouts pop up!
segs: Warm spring has come. Little sprouts pop up!

lines.text: 개미들은 다시 뚜벅뚜벅 줄지어 먹이를 날랐어요.
lines.en: The ants marched in a line again, stomp, stomp, carrying food.
segs: The ants marched in a line again, stomp, stomp, carrying food.

lines.text: 이번엔 베짱이도 함께 날라요.
lines.en: This time the grasshopper carries food too.
segs: This time the grasshopper carries food too.

lines.text: "영차! 여름엔 노래하고, 일도 함께 할래요!"
lines.en: "Heave-ho! I'll sing in summer, and work together, too!"
segs: Heave-ho! I'll sing in summer, and work together, too!

lines.text: 개미들은 베짱이를 보고 방긋방긋 웃었어요.
lines.en: The ants looked at the grasshopper and grinned from ear to ear.
segs: The ants looked at the grasshopper and grinned from ear to ear.

lines.text: 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울! 계절은 빙글빙글 돌아요.
lines.en: Spring, summer, autumn, winter! The seasons go round and round.
segs: Spring, summer, autumn, winter! The seasons go round and round.

lines.text: 미리 준비하고 함께 나누니, 겨울도 따뜻했답니다.
lines.en: By getting ready ahead and sharing together, even winter was warm.
segs: By getting ready ahead and sharing together, even winter was warm.
